title: Senior Career Coach, Tech Programs
description:
About: Pathlight Labs is a coaching platform helping mid-career professionals in tech navigate transitions, promotions, and layoffs. We serve 40,000 members through a blend of on-demand content and live coaching.

What you'll do:
- Deliver 1:1 coaching sessions to a caseload of 25-30 tech professionals per week
- Run mock interviews and salary negotiation prep grounded in real recruiting practice
- Design and facilitate small-group workshops on job search strategy
- Contribute to our coaching playbooks and session frameworks
- Track member outcomes and iterate with our product team

What we're looking for: 6+ years combined experience in recruiting, career coaching, or talent advisory. You have sat on the hiring side and can decode what recruiters actually want. ICF or similar certification is a plus, not a requirement. Comfortable coaching over video all day and writing clear, direct feedback. This is a fully remote US role. Base salary: $125,000-$150,000 plus equity and a professional development stipend.

title: Senior Manager, Career Services
description:
About: Forgeline Academy runs immersive software engineering and data bootcamps with a job-outcomes guarantee. Career services is the heart of that promise.

What you'll do:
- Own placement outcomes for cohorts of 80-120 graduates per quarter
- Lead and coach a team of 5 career coaches
- Build employer partnerships and hiring pipelines with startups and scaleups
- Design the career curriculum: resume sprints, interview gauntlets, negotiation labs
- Report placement metrics to leadership and our accreditation partners

What we're looking for: 7+ years in career services, recruiting, or talent programs, including time managing coaches or recruiters. You understand hiring funnels from both sides and can turn that into repeatable programming. Data fluency matters; you will live in dashboards. Remote-first company, US-based; we gather twice a year in person. Base salary $130,000-$155,000 depending on experience, plus bonus tied to placement outcomes (on top of base, never instead of it).

title: Senior Program Lead, Coaching Experience
description:
About: Tessera Health Partners is a 35-person startup building a modern EAP where career support sits alongside mental health benefits. Our career coaching line is our fastest-growing offering.

What you'll do:
- Own the end-to-end coaching program: coach recruitment, onboarding, QA, and member experience
- Recruit, vet, and credential a network of contract career coaches
- Carry a light personal caseload (4-6 members weekly) to stay close to the work
- Define quality rubrics and run session reviews and calibration
- Partner with sales on employer-facing program reporting

What we're looking for: 7+ years across recruiting, coaching, or people programs, with experience building something from scratch. You can both deliver a great coaching session and design the system that makes 50 coaches deliver them consistently. Fully remote within the US. Base salary $128,000-$145,000 plus meaningful early-stage equity.

title: Career Coach, University Partnerships
description:
About: Northgate Collective partners with universities to modernize their career centers, embedding experienced coaches who serve students and alumni at scale.

What you'll do:
- Coach a caseload of upper-division students and recent alumni through internship and full-time searches
- Facilitate weekly workshops on interviewing, networking, and offer evaluation
- Build relationships with regional employers and coordinate campus recruiting events
- Use assessment tools to help undecided students find direction
- Contribute to our shared coaching methodology across partner campuses

What we're looking for: 5+ years in career coaching, advising, or recruiting. Experience on the employer side is a real advantage; students trust coaches who have made hiring decisions. This is a hybrid role based in Denver: three days on campus with our university partner, two days remote. Base salary $110,000-$128,000 plus benefits and a generous university holiday calendar.

title: Lead Career Coach
description:
About: Windrose Outplacement Group supports employees through layoffs and restructurings on behalf of employer clients across the Midwest. We believe a layoff handled well can be a turning point, not a scar.

What you'll do:
- Coach displaced professionals from IC through VP level on search strategy, positioning, and resilience
- Lead a pod of three coaches: case reviews, mentoring, quality standards
- Deliver on-site notification-day support and group transition workshops for client companies
- Write and edit executive-level resumes and LinkedIn profiles
- Serve as day-to-day contact for two anchor employer accounts

What we're looking for: 6+ years in coaching, HR, or recruiting; prior outplacement experience strongly preferred. Calm under pressure, empathetic without losing candor. Hybrid schedule from our Chicago loop office (2-3 days per week), with occasional local travel to client sites. Competitive salary and full benefits; compensation discussed in the first conversation.

title: Career Coach, Product-Led Coaching
skills: async coaching via chat and video
description:
About: Kelpwood is a 28-person startup building an AI-assisted career copilot. Human coaches are core to the product; you will shape how the software coaches, not just coach alongside it.

What you'll do:
- Coach members through async messaging and scheduled video sessions
- Review AI-drafted coaching suggestions and correct them; your judgment trains the product
- Create short-form coaching content: negotiation scripts, outreach templates, interview drills
- Join weekly product reviews and user research calls as the voice of coaching craft
- Pilot new offerings like offer-deadline sprint coaching

What we're looking for: 4+ years coaching or recruiting experience and genuine curiosity about AI tools. You write exceptionally well; half your coaching happens in text. Fully remote in the US. Base salary $105,000-$125,000 plus early-stage equity that we think is the real upside here.

title: Manager, Alumni Career Programs
description:
About: Halberd University Online serves 90,000 working-adult students and a global alumni base. The Alumni Career Programs team keeps graduates employed, promoted, and proud.

What you'll do:
- Run our flagship programs: the alumni mentorship match, quarterly virtual career fairs, and the mid-career pivot series
- Deliver a limited coaching caseload for high-touch alumni segments
- Recruit and manage volunteer alumni mentors and industry speakers
- Own program metrics: registration, completion, employment outcomes
- Coordinate with marketing on program promotion and storytelling

What we're looking for: 4-6 years in career services, program management, or talent development. Comfort producing large virtual events and wrangling Salesforce reports. Coaching certification welcome but not required. Hybrid from our Phoenix campus, three days on-site. Full university benefits including tuition remission for you and dependents.

title: Coaching Program Lead, Enterprise Accounts
description:
About: Brightmark Coaching Co. sells career and leadership coaching as a benefit to enterprise employers. Program Leads make each account's coaching program actually work.

What you'll do:
- Own program delivery for 6-8 enterprise accounts (2,000-20,000 eligible employees each)
- Design launches, comms plans, and manager enablement to drive coaching utilization
- Match employees to the right coaches and monitor quality signals
- Run quarterly business reviews with HR leaders using utilization and outcome data
- Feed client insight back to product and coach-network teams

What we're looking for: 6+ years in program delivery, client success, or talent programs; coaching or recruiting background is a strong plus since you will speak both languages daily. Confident presenting to CHROs. Hybrid from our Boston office, two days a week. Base salary $115,000-$135,000 plus annual bonus. Occasional travel to client sites, roughly once a quarter.

title: Director of Career Services
description:
About: Meridian Trades Institute trains electricians, HVAC technicians, and welders across three Ohio campuses. Our graduates keep the lights on, literally.

What you'll do:
- Lead a nine-person career services department across all three campuses
- Own placement-rate compliance reporting for accreditation and Title IV requirements
- Chair employer advisory boards and grow apprenticeship pipelines with regional contractors
- Manage the department budget and hire and develop coaching staff
- Represent the institute at workforce development boards and community events

What we're looking for: 8+ years in career services or workforce development with at least 3 years managing teams. Familiarity with accreditation placement standards is essential; trades or vocational context is a plus. This position is based on-site at our Columbus campus with regular day trips to Dayton and Toledo locations. Salary range $98,000-$118,000 with state-comparable benefits and pension participation.

title: Junior Career Coach
description:
About: Loftbridge Careers helps new grads and early-career switchers land their first roles in tech-adjacent fields. We are a scrappy 20-person team that answers every member message within a day.

What you'll do:
- Deliver resume and cover letter reviews with fast, specific written feedback
- Host drop-in coaching hours and application accountability check-ins
- Moderate our member community and surface common questions to the content team
- Support senior coaches on mock interview days
- Keep meticulous session notes in our coaching platform

What we're looking for: 1-3 years in coaching, recruiting coordination, campus career services, or a related people-facing role. You give feedback that is kind and unmistakably clear. Genuine enthusiasm for early-career job seekers; this audience is our whole company. Fully remote within the US. Base salary $62,000-$74,000 with a clear promotion path to Coach II within 18 months for strong performers.

title: Career Transition Consultant
description:
About: Stellar Ascent Advisors sells premium career transition packages ($3,000-$15,000) directly to executives and professionals in transition. Our consultants both sell and deliver.

What you'll do:
- Run discovery calls with inbound leads and close coaching packages
- Deliver the coaching engagements you sell: strategy sessions, resume overhauls, interview prep
- Follow up relentlessly on your pipeline; speed-to-lead wins deals here
- Upsell add-on services like LinkedIn rewrites and salary negotiation support
- Hit monthly revenue targets and report pipeline in our CRM

What we're looking for: 3+ years in coaching, recruiting, or high-ticket consultative sales. Hunger matters more than pedigree. Please note: this role is 100% commission-based with no base salary. Top consultants earn $150,000-$250,000; typical first-year earnings are $60,000-$90,000 while you build a book. Work from anywhere in the US. We provide leads, training, and all delivery materials.

title: National Workshop Facilitator, Career Transitions
description:
About: Crossgate Transition Services is the outplacement partner large employers call when a restructuring affects hundreds of employees at once. Our facilitators are the calm, credible presence in the room on the hardest day.

What you'll do:
- Deliver on-site career transition workshops at client locations nationwide
- Provide notification-day support: same-day coaching for impacted employees
- Adapt our standard curriculum to each client's industry and workforce
- Coordinate room logistics, materials, and follow-up scheduling with client HR
- Debrief every engagement with account managers to sharpen delivery

What we're looking for: 6+ years in facilitation, coaching, or HR, with proven command of rooms of 50-200 people. Grace under genuinely difficult emotional circumstances. Expect 100% travel: you will be on the road at client sites four to five days every week, year-round, flying most Sundays or Mondays. Base salary $95,000-$115,000 plus full travel expenses, per diem, and airline status that takes care of itself.

title: Career Services Advisor
description:
About: Ridgemont Staffing Institute operates career training centers across Florida, preparing students for administrative, medical office, and light industrial roles. Our Tampa center serves about 300 active students.

What you'll do:
- Staff the career services desk and greet students during walk-in hours
- Post job openings to our internal board and match students to openings
- Cold call local employers to source entry-level openings
- Track student attendance and complete placement paperwork for compliance files
- Schedule employer visits and set up the room for hiring events

What we're looking for: 1-2 years of customer service, staffing, or administrative experience. High school diploma required; associate degree preferred. Reliable, organized, and friendly at the front desk. This is a fully on-site position at our Tampa center, Monday through Friday, 8:30am-5:30pm; remote work is not available for this role. Pay range $44,000-$52,000 with medical benefits after 90 days and two weeks PTO.
